An '''Ion Emitter''' was a component of an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] used on [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]] such as the [[Mark III Merr-Sonn Defender Ion Mine]]. It was located at the end of the [[Mine/Legends|mine's]] in-built ion cannon.<ref name="EGWT" />
